brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Pair 1: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full. Pair 2: piece:3,-3,0;full + piece:4,-3,0;full — four bases forming two distinct clusters.

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (internal joins are side connectors, no other joining method)
requirements.evidence: connector:0#0,0|0,1 joins pair 1, connector:0#3,-3|4,-3 joins pair 2 — both side-connector-double. No piece adjacency or other connector types between bases. If brief intended the two pairs to also be bridged to each other by a side connector, that bridging connector is not present — pairs are currently separate islands — would be unmet for that interpretation.

finish.summary: Built two islands of two bases each, each island internally locked with a single side-connector-double (0,0-0,1 and 3,-3-4,-3). Mesh clear, no caps required per house rules deferral.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
